WITH country_avgs AS (
  SELECT
    c.country,
    AVG(cs.points) AS avg_points,
    AVG(cs.wins) AS avg_wins
  FROM constructorStandings cs
  JOIN races r ON cs.raceId = r.raceId
  JOIN circuits c ON r.circuitId = c.circuitId
  GROUP BY c.country
),
overall_avg_wins AS (
  SELECT AVG(avg_wins) AS overall_avg_wins
  FROM country_avgs
)
SELECT
  ca.country,
  ca.avg_points,
  ca.avg_wins,
  ca.avg_wins - oa.overall_avg_wins AS wins_diff_from_overall_avg
FROM country_avgs ca
CROSS JOIN overall_avg_wins oa
ORDER BY ca.country

assumptions.assumption: We compute averages of the season-to-date running totals from constructorStandings, not the raw points/wins earned at races in each country. The 'average wins' for a country is the mean of the wins values at all races held there, where each wins value is itself a season-to-date count at that point in the season.
